the cards as well. Example:

Condtioning
After playing this card, you cannot play another action modifier to
further increase the bleed for this action.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <91bhno$i9a$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, francoi...@my-deja.com
writes

>It is usually written on cards.
>I think you can add just 1 sup. Command of the Beast to the first
>action mod.

You would have to play Command of the Beast first.

The text on Conditioning (or whatever other card you played) would
prohibit you from playing Command of the Beast after that.

And, for the original poster, since you can only play one copy of each
named action modifier per action anyway, along with the restrictions on
card text, you could only play 1 Command of the Beast anyway.

> Can someone pls confirm that, at the present state of the rules, only
